timing_scope.training_ms: RP-BEAR validation(학습) phase wall-clock = sim.py val_total_ms (data load / NBG 생성 / agent 저장 / test / 평가 제외). Method B = N/A
timing_scope.test_repair_mean_ms_per_case / median: A / C / C+PN: case별 timer (worker 안 perf_counter, multiprocessing CPU 공유 포함; C+PN은 Petri Net gate 포함). B: case별 align_case + repair_from_alignment (순차)
timing_scope.test_wall_ms_per_case: test phase wall-clock / test cases (A / C / C+PN은 multiprocessing throughput)
timing_scope.preprocessing: discovery_ms / generation_ms / nbg_build_ms = discover / generate / nbg stage 기록값 (있을 때만)
